qr.rule: Composite the authentic QR directly over the generated design. Do not reserve a blank panel; keep only headline, body copy, face, and essential label details outside this exact coverage area.

logo.rule: Composite the official logo directly over the generated design. Do not reserve a blank panel; keep only headline, body copy, face, and essential label details outside this exact coverage area.

base_rule: The design may continue naturally through the lower area with people, texture, objects, and structural elements. Never create a blank bottom band, white rectangle, card, or color-block placeholder for the post-composited assets.
